# Hypertext Towerfall

A Biblical word-study trading card game. Every card is a word found in the Bible, printed
with the Hebrew and Greek lemmas behind it — the verses it appears in, how often the original
words occur, and what they actually mean — on a face you play with rather than revise from.
You play in English; the languages are there to be learned from, not read.

**Set one, "Babel Alpha": 90 Word Cards and 30 Lots**, generated by the pipeline in this
repository, gated card by card, signed, and printed for playtesting.

**Status: pre-alpha.** Two playtested iterations, a third on the way, one physical deck
ordered from The Game Crafter. Publication is targeted for 2027.

- **Play it in your browser:** <https://hypertext-game.fly.dev> — solitaire against the
  clock, or against the computer. No install, phone or desktop. Source:
  [Hypertext — Game](https://github.com/bobbyhiddn/Hypertext-Game)
- **The game, how it plays, and how it was built:** <https://bobbyhiddn.github.io/Hypertext/>
- **Every card face:** <https://bobbyhiddn.github.io/Hypertext/gallery/>
- **Rules of play:** [docs/rules.md](docs/rules.md)

## The set

Two to six players write a **Chapter** together, revealing Word Cards from a shared 90-card
Tower, spending them for their abilities, and **Recording** exact combinations of grammatical
types to score. Seven or more players needs two sets shuffled together.

| | | | | |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **Types** | NOUN 16 | VERB 20 | ADJECTIVE 20 | NAME 16 · TITLE 18 |
| **Rarities** | COMMON 36 | UNCOMMON 31 | RARE 14 | GLORIOUS 9 |

| Type | On the table |
|------|--------------|
| NOUN | Person, place, or thing |
| VERB | Action word |
| ADJECTIVE | Descriptive word |
| NAME | Proper name |
| TITLE | Wild: stands for a NOUN or a NAME, or collects as its own suit for double points |

| Rarity | Chip | What the ability may do |
|--------|------|-------------------------|
| COMMON | White circle | Beat a plain draw, modestly |
| UNCOMMON | Green square | Beat two cards' worth |
| RARE | Gold hexagon | Three or more, may reach every player or scale off a structure |
| GLORIOUS | Orange rhombus | Five or more, or bend a structure — a steep printed cost may buy it |

## How the set is built

The interesting part was never the generation. A model will happily produce ninety cards that
each look fine and collectively make no sense, so almost everything that made the set coherent
is a check that can fail a card rather than a better prompt.

```
DESIGN   curator → designs module → offline_check → driver daemon
         (no renders spent; any finding rewrites the design)

BUILD    plan → render → stamp fixed elements → gates
         (one card at a time; one defect repairs that defect only,
          many defects re-render, six strikes and it stops)

SET      audits → curator review → tgc prep → printer
```

Two things feed the render step, and neither is the prompt:

- **20 blank card templates** — five types × four rarities — plus **3 Lot templates** for the
  5-, 6- and 7-card recipes. The frame, the rarity chip and the cost glyphs are already correct
  before a word is chosen. `tools/verify_template_package.py` fails the build if a cell is
  missing or corrupt; there is no legacy fallback.
- **A few finished cards as exemplars**, drawn only from a curated manifest and only from the
  card's own type and rarity. A card has to be promoted to be eligible, so one bad render can
  never become the style everything else copies.

Reference order is TEMPLATE first, then exemplars. In fix mode it is the card itself first,
then the template, then exemplars — so the model edits rather than reinvents.

**Gates** run on every render: stat pips, rarity chip and cost glyphs by pixel; exact ability
text, placeholder leaks and a 3-vote style match by vision. **Set audits** run across all
ninety: no duplicate ability shape, no shared lemma, word-weight floors, mechanic-axis
coverage, art-motif caps, rarity census. Everything fails closed.

Models: **`gemini-3.1-flash-image`** for faces, **`gemini-3.7-flash`** for text and review.

## Repository structure

```
Hypertext/
├── series/
│   ├── 2026-Q1/              # The set
│   │   ├── cards/            # Source of truth: one folder per card
│   │   ├── lots/faces/       # 30 Lot faces (flat PNG package) + manifest
│   │   ├── deck/queue.yml    # What is still to be built
│   │   ├── tgc_prep/         # PRINT-READY OUTPUT, committed with the set
│   │   ├── tracker/          # Generated set tracker page
│   │   ├── set-standards.yml # Grid targets, mechanic axes, stat and art rules
│   │   ├── stats.yml         # Live census
│   │   └── cards_index.yml   # Canonical card list
│   └── 2026-Q1-dev/          # Scratch series for pipeline work
├── package/hypertext/        # The library (cards, gemini, lots, tgc, gallery, cli)
├── package/tests/            # 286 passing, 11 skipped
├── scripts/pipeline/         # batch_run, selfheal, replan, offline_check, designs/, lot_gates
├── scripts/site/             # wrap_page.py — builds the Pages landing page
├── templates/                # 20 card templates, 3 Lot templates, both backs
├── schema/                   # Card schema, ability grammar, template matrix, contracts
├── tools/                    # verify_template_package.py
├── docs/                     # rules, ability grammar, style guide, print how-tos, promo art
└── .claude/skills/           # hypertext-generation, gemini-gen
```

## Quick start

```bash
python3 -m venv .venv
.venv/bin/python -m pip install -e 'package[test]'
export HYPERTEXT_PY="$PWD/.venv/bin/python" HYPERTEXT_HX="$PWD/.venv/bin/hypertext"
```

`HYPERTEXT_HX` is not optional: without it every gate prints `pip fail` while still burning a
render. `GEMINI_API_KEY` lives in a gitignored `.env`, loaded with `set -a; . ./.env; set +a` —
never passed as an argument.

1. **Check the batch on paper**, before a render is spent. A batch is a designs module
   (`DESIGNS[word] = (rarity, seed, candidate)` plus `META` and `TYPES`); pre-flight runs every
   deterministic set rule against it and exits non-zero on any finding:
   ```bash
   .venv/bin/python scripts/pipeline/offline_check.py scripts/pipeline/designs/<batch>.py
   ```
2. **Plan a card**:
   ```bash
   .venv/bin/python -m hypertext.pipeline.daily --phase plan --series series/2026-Q1 --auto
   ```
3. **Render, gate and grade** (rebuild → stamp → gates → 3-vote grade → fix mode):
   ```bash
   REGEN=1 scripts/pipeline/selfheal.sh 001-grace
   ```
4. **Audit the whole set**:
   ```bash
   .venv/bin/python -m hypertext.cli lemma-audit    --series series/2026-Q1
   .venv/bin/python -m hypertext.cli ability-audit  --series series/2026-Q1
   .venv/bin/python -m hypertext.cli axis-audit     --series series/2026-Q1
   .venv/bin/python -m hypertext.cli art-audit      --series series/2026-Q1
   .venv/bin/python -m hypertext.cli weight-audit   --series series/2026-Q1
   .venv/bin/python -m hypertext.cli grammar-check  --series series/2026-Q1
   ```
5. **Prepare for print**, then commit the output:
   ```bash
   .venv/bin/python -m hypertext.tgc prep --cards-dir series/2026-Q1/cards
   ```

## Print output lives with the set

`series/<id>/tgc_prep/` is committed, so the exact files sent to the printer are recoverable
for any past state of the set:

```
tgc_prep/
├── cards/batch_01..04/   # 90 faces, 25 per upload batch
├── cards/back/           # navy Word back
├── lots/batch_01..02/    # 30 Lot faces
└── lots/back/            # green Lot back
```

Every file is exactly 825 × 1125 (The Game Crafter Poker Deck, 2.5″ × 3.5″ plus bleed). Faces
are 2:3 and the card is 5:7, so they are **frame-fit** — scaled uniformly into the safe zone on
a mat sampled from the face's own border — never stretched or cropped. Regenerate after any
card changes, and upload one batch folder at a time plus each deck's back.

## Watermarking

Every face carries a cryptographic sigil burned into the PNG: a 5×5 grid encoding an
HMAC-SHA256 signature of the card's identity, keyed by `HYPERTEXT_SIGNING_KEY`. The pipeline
**fails closed** when the key is absent — a card cannot be built unsigned unless
`HYPERTEXT_WATERMARK_OPTIONAL` is set deliberately.

```bash
.venv/bin/python -m hypertext.cli watermark --help
```
